originalTitle: Paul Tudor Jones says 2027 could be a really challenging year for the stock market
summary: The billionaire investor said that corporate buybacks, along with mergers and acquisitions, that have been a tail wind for the bull market are about to turn.
content:
Legendary hedge fund manager Paul Tudor Jones told CNBC that next year could be a tough one for the stock market because of increased equity supply from big tech initial public offerings coming down the pipe as well as a potential reckoning from the ballooning U.S. fiscal deficit.

"2027 is going to be really, really challenging for the stock market," Jones told " Squawk Box " on Tuesday. "You've probably got the most negative flow picture for the U.S. stock market that we've had, say, since 2002."

The founder and chief investment officer of Tudor Investment said that corporate buybacks, along with mergers and acquisitions, have been a tail wind for the stock market for most of this four-year bull market as they decreased the equity supply.

That tide is now turning against the market with major offerings ahead in the AI space from Anthropic and OpenAI, along with one just finished for SpaceX . There will also likely be more secondary offerings from companies in order to raise money for the AI build-out, said Jones. It all adds up to an increased equity supply picture that could weigh on prices.

The billionaire hedge fund manager's comments come as investors worry that a bull market now in its fourth year could start to dwindle and run out of steam as concerns grow around mounting inflation, higher bond yields and a more hawkish Federal Reserve.

Jones repeated that the current period in the market is akin to 1999 , just about a year before the dot-com bubble burst in 2000. He noted the bifurcation in the current market between those companies benefiting from the AI boom and those that aren't.

He also added that a ballooning fiscal deficit is among the dangers for the current stock market, for which he thinks there could be a reckoning.

"We're never going to fix these deficits until the market makes us to. It's going to be just like 2008 and TARP [Troubled Asset Relief Program]. So that's the reality. No politician is going to voluntarily raise taxes or cut spending. They're going to be forced to," he said.

"And the only question is, are we now at that tipping point where the market's about to do that? And if you put a gun to my head, I'd say 60-40, we're down that path," Jones said.

Oil, which he is long, is another headwind for the market, according to the hedge fund manager. He contended that prices could rally another $20 to $25 after the midterms , a scenario that the stock market will "hate" if it comes to pass.

"I'll be short the whole year. There just — there's little value," Jones said. "You had all this issuance, all these IPOs in '98 and '99, and really 2000, 2001, 2002. Those were the easiest years to be short because you kept having these unlocks that just kept adding supply to the market."
chineseTitle: 保罗·都铎·琼斯 (Paul Tudor Jones) 表示 2027 年对股市来说可能是真正充满挑战的一年
chineseSummary: 这位亿万富翁投资者表示，企业回购以及并购一直是牛市的顺风，即将扭转。
chineseContent:
传奇对冲基金经理保罗·都铎·琼斯 (Paul Tudor Jones) 告诉 CNBC，明年对股市来说可能是艰难的一年，因为大型科技公司首次公开募股 (IPO) 的股票供应量增加，而且美国不断膨胀的财政赤字可能带来清算。

琼斯周二对“Squawk Box”表示：“2027 年对股市来说将是非常非常具有挑战性的。” “你可能看到了美国股市自 2002 年以来最负面的流量图。”

都铎投资公司的创始人兼首席投资官表示，在这四年牛市的大部分时间里，企业回购以及并购一直是股市的顺风，因为它们减少了股票供应。

现在，这种趋势正在逆转市场，Anthropic 和 OpenAI 在人工智能领域的主要产品即将推出，SpaceX 刚刚完成了一项产品。琼斯表示，公司也可能会进行更多的二次发行，以便为人工智能建设筹集资金。所有这些都导致股票供应量增加，可能会对价格造成压力。

这位亿万富翁对冲基金经理发表上述言论之际，投资者担心，随着人们对通胀加剧、债券收益率上升和美联储立场更加强硬的担忧加剧，进入第四个年头的牛市可能会开始萎缩并失去动力。

琼斯重申，目前的市场时期类似于 1999 年，即 2000 年互联网泡沫破裂的前一年。他指出，当前市场中受益于人工智能繁荣的公司和未受益于人工智能繁荣的公司之间存在分歧。

他还补充说，不断膨胀的财政赤字是当前股市面临的危险之一，他认为可能需要对此进行清算。

“除非市场要求我们解决这些赤字，否则我们永远不会解决这些赤字。这将像2008年和TARP（问题资产救助计划）一样。这就是现实。没有政客会自愿提高税收或削减支出。他们将被迫这样做，”他说。

“唯一的问题是，我们现在是否正处于市场即将发生这种情况的临界点？如果你用枪指着我的头，我会说 60-40，我们就走上了这条路，”琼斯说。

这位对冲基金经理表示，他做多的石油是市场的另一个阻力。他认为，中期选举后价格可能会再上涨 20 至 25 美元，如果这种情况发生，股市将“讨厌”这种情况。

“我会全年做空。这没什么价值，”琼斯说。 “98 年和 99 年，甚至是 2000 年、2001 年、2002 年，你都进行了所有这些发行、IPO。那些是最容易做空的年份，因为你不断地释放这些股票，从而不断增加市场的供应。”
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
